en: Two-sided vintage postcard. The address side is plain with Hungarian headings "Levelező-lap." and "Czim" and a boxed area for a stamp. The picture side shows a black‑and‑white photograph of a church with a dome and bell tower and, in front of it, a large Baroque plague column/statue in a town square. Below the image are bilingual captions in Hungarian and German indicating the location as the inner-city church on Széchenyi Square in Pécs (Fünfkirchen).
